implement.name: The spec is written first
implement.summary: Load the feature that owns the rule before writing code, and update it when the rule moves

implement.name: One test per acceptance criterion
implement.summary: Criteria carry stable identifiers and become the tests — that is what makes them acceptance criteria

review.name: Spec and code moved together
review.summary: A behaviour changed with no spec entry, or a spec changed with no code, is the gap a diff-only reviewer cannot see
